name: ns_proofsearch_frontier
rubric_version_reason: Repair Newton preflight, add qualitative gate opt-outs, and admit geometric/gauge proof-search competitors.
description: Bounded ZTARE substrate for advancing the current Navier-Stokes pressure-l=2 proof frontier by finding a theorem-shaped bridge, obstruction, or justified reranking among the live obligations.

cage_meta.class_reason: This is a qualitative proof-search audit over named theorem obligations. It is not a numeric farther-tail substrate and has no finite target rows.

farther_tail_region_disable_reason: No numeric farther-tail coordinate exists. Progress is judged by theorem-shaped bridge quality, obligation specificity, and claim discipline.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Qualitative theorem-cage proof-search substrate with no numeric target law.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rival routes are scored by theorem-cost and unpaid-term honesty, not by formula-gap heuristics.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE proof-search referee. You do not reward beautiful prose, only theorem-shaped progress on the current pressure-l=2 Navier-Stokes frontier. You force the candidate to choose or rerank a live obligation, state the bridge or obstruction in repo-native terms, and explicitly name what remains unpaid. You reject generic Sobolev fallback, hidden fixed exponents, fake exact cancellation, and any claim of Clay-level closure.

dimensions.name: Obligation Ranking and Route Choice
dimensions.description: Does the thesis correctly identify which ranked obligation it attacks, or justify a reranking with a load-bearing comparative argument?

dimensions.name: Theorem-Shaped Bridge Specificity
dimensions.description: Does the submission state a concrete theorem-shaped bridge or obstruction in repo-native terms, rather than generic PDE prose?

dimensions.name: Singular-Integral Discipline
dimensions.description: If the route touches the commutator tower or pressure tail, does it use singular-integral / commutator structure rather than generic Sobolev embedding?

dimensions.name: Residual and Unpaid-Term Honesty
dimensions.description: Does the thesis explicitly name what remains unpaid, including residual terms, instead of laundering them into notation?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis produce a real next theorem target, obstruction, or route re-ranking that would change what to build next?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the thesis avoid overclaiming Navier-Stokes regularity or exact cancellations not earned by the current branch?

criteria.Obligation_Ranking_and_Route_Choice: Full credit requires attacking or reranking one of the four live obligations in the packet with explicit comparative reasoning.
criteria.Theorem_Shaped_Bridge_Specificity: Full credit requires a theorem-shaped bridge, obstruction, or reranking in repo-native terms such as pressureL2TransportDefectObligation, phase5cgBroadProofSearchTarget, globalPressureTailBootstrap, or commutatorTowerProofSearchTarget.
criteria.Singular_Integral_Discipline: Generic Sobolev-only arguments fail if the route is supposed to address commutators or pressure tails. Kato-Ponce / Coifman-Meyer class reasoning is preferred where relevant.
criteria.Residual_and_Unpaid_Term_Honesty: The thesis must explicitly name residuals or missing coercive estimates. Hiding them inside notation or asserting exact cancellation fails this dimension.
criteria.Generative_Yield: A good submission changes the next build or proof step by producing a sharper target or a clean impossibility witness.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject claims of Clay-level closure, exact cancellation, or fixed-rate decay unless explicitly derived.
